messages.author: 3908a2da5354fc44
messages.subject: Bootstrap Errors
parts:
When using the bootstrap option with 500 bootstraps I received about 25
warning messages of convergence failure. Does this completely
invalidate the use of CIs from the bootstrap procedure, or is the number
of resampling runs reduced by the number of runs where convergence
failed? The help file is unclear on this point.

I know from using the simulation procedure in SURVIV that it is not
uncommon for a few runs to fail to converge because some individual
resampled datasets are "weird"; however, these failed runs are excluded
from the output. I noticed that DISTANCE still provide CIs when you
have convergence problems, but the number of runs listed is the same as
the input specification.

Thanks,

Duane
